alerts.title: Declared object permission check is missing on a return path
alerts.description: A DRF view with an identifiable object-level policy returns lookup-derived data without an observed check on that object. This is bounded static evidence, not verified deployment exploitability.
alerts.recommendation: Check the same requested object using the declared object-permission policy before exposing it.

obligation.required: Check the same requested object using the declared object-permission policy before exposing it.
obligation.observed: A DRF view with an identifiable object-level policy returns lookup-derived data without an observed check on that object.
assumptions: Queryset filtering, alternate checks and deployment reachability may affect actual exposure.

alerts.title: Returned claims are parsed outside the verified JWS payload
alerts.description: A keyed JWS deserialization accepts one payload representation, while returned claims are independently decoded from a compact-token segment. This is bounded static evidence, not verified deployment exploitability.
alerts.recommendation: Return claims decoded from the verifier payload, or establish equality with that exact payload before returning them.

obligation.required: Return claims decoded from the verifier payload, or establish equality with that exact payload before returning them.
obligation.observed: A keyed JWS deserialization accepts one payload representation, while returned claims are independently decoded from a compact-token segment.
assumptions: The resolved jwcrypto JWS API may accept compact and JSON representations.
A non-null verification key, caller trust boundary and claim use remain runtime assumptions.

alerts.title: HMAC key blacklist omits recognized public-key formats
alerts.description: A finite public-key rejection list guards material stored for a resolved HMAC operation, but omits: ssh-ed25519, ssh-dss, ecdsa-sha2-nistp256, ecdsa-sha2-nistp384, ecdsa-sha2-nistp521. This is bounded static evidence, not verified deployment exploitability.
alerts.recommendation: Use a complete key-format/type boundary before accepting asymmetric representations as HMAC secrets.

obligation.required: Use a complete key-format/type boundary before accepting asymmetric representations as HMAC secrets.
obligation.observed: A finite public-key rejection list guards material stored for a resolved HMAC operation, but omits: ssh-ed25519, ssh-dss, ecdsa-sha2-nistp256, ecdsa-sha2-nistp384, ecdsa-sha2-nistp521.
assumptions: This checks the visible finite blacklist, not all possible key-format parsers or caller restrictions.
Accepting omitted representations and an attacker-relevant verifier configuration require runtime validation.
